channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye neutralizes threats at source beyond its borders: Erdoğan
item.description: Türkiye takes all necessary steps beyond its borders for its security, neutralizing threats at their source without seeking permission from anyone, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Thursday.

item.title: Three cities, nine stars, one signature
item.description: Björn Frantzén is the only chef in the world currently operating three Michelin three-star restaurants simultaneously in three different cities. FZN in Dubai proves that this achievement is not an expansion story, but the portability of a system.

item.title: Istanbul’s most crowded district rejects its image of crime hub
item.description: Long framed in public debate as a hot spot for crime and disorder, Istanbul’s most populous district, Esenyurt, is fighting to shed its stigma by centering its identity on industrial power and working-class resilience, even as residents navigate the growing pains of rapid urbanization and rising costs.

item.title: Gaziantep exhibition highlights 400 years of ties between Netherlands, Türkiye
item.description: From 17th-century merchant routes to modern-day disaster relief, a newly opened exhibition in the southern city of Gaziantep offers a powerful look at the 400-year bond between the Netherlands and Türkiye.

item.title: Younger generation breathes new life into Istanbul’s time-resistant niche crafts
item.description: Driven by a Gen Z-led fascination with nostalgia, Istanbul’s antique clock and turntable trades are undergoing a revival that preserves cultural heritage while generating significant economic value through rising global demand.

item.title: Türkiye and Saudi Arabia sign landmark solar power deal
item.description: Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar announced that Türkiye and Saudi Arabia have signed a renewable energy agreement under which Saudi energy company ACWA Power will build solar power plants in Sivas and Karaman Taşeli.

item.title: Türkiye ready to contribute to Gaza 'in every way possible': FM Fidan
item.description: Türkiye is ready to contribute to Gaza "in every way possible," Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said Thursday.

item.title: Erdoğan says renewables reach 62 pct of installed capacity
item.description: Türkiye has increased the share of renewables in its total installed electricity capacity to 62 percent by expanding wind and solar power, President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Friday.

item.title: Trump says weighing strike on Iran as Tehran says draft deal coming soon
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said he was considering a limited strike on Iran after ordering a major naval buildup in the Middle East aimed at heaping pressure on Tehran to cut a deal to curb its nuclear programme.

item.title: Trump imposes 10 pct global tariff after stinging court rebuke
item.description: President Donald Trump imposed Friday an additional 10 percent tariff on imports into the United States after the Supreme Court struck down many of his sweeping and often arbitrary duties, delivering a stinging rebuke on his signature economic policy.
